description: ASEP Clientes, energía y facturación por distribuidora año is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Muestra la cantidad de clientes de cada una de las empresas distribuidoras, muestra la energía vendida a dichos clientes en MWh y muestra los montos facturados, en Balboas, por las tres empresas distribuidoras de electricidad en Panamá, en el año 2019. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos . Its tags are mercado mayorista, regulador. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2021-10-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
